signature.name: VTask.mkContinuous
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u} -> {E : Type wE} -> {F : Type wF} -> {ι : Type v} -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] -> [Fintype ι] -> (f : E [⋀^ι]→ₗ[𝕜] F) -> (C : ℝ) -> (H : ∀ (m : ι → E), ‖f m‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖m i‖) -> E [⋀^ι]→L[𝕜] F

conventions.statement: The constant C is not required to be non-negative; if C < 0, the hypothesis H forces f to be identically zero, and the construction remains valid.
conventions.note: When C < 0, the operator norm bound max C 0 = 0 is used instead of C itself.

conventions.point: Operator norm bound with possibly negative C
conventions.statement: For any C (possibly negative), the operator norm of the result satisfies ‖VTask.mkContinuous f C H‖ ≤ max C 0.
conventions.note: When 0 ≤ C, this specialises to ‖VTask.mkContinuous f C H‖ ≤ C.

facts.statement: ∀ {𝕜 : Type*} {E : Type*} {F : Type*} {ι : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [Fintype ι] (f : E [⋀^ι]→ₗ[𝕜] F) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (H : ∀ m : ι → E, ‖f m‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖m i‖), ‖VTask.mkContinuous f C H‖ ≤ C
